purpose: Prevent Buddy from entering broad college study as a passive knowledge task; require demonstrated software-engineering competence first.
anti_shortcut_rules: No graduation from aggregate score alone.
Every critical security or reliability gate must pass.
At least three unseen evaluation sets are required.
At least one existing-repository challenge is required.
At least one recovery challenge is required.
At least one teach-back explanation must be judged correct.
Scores must retain baseline, attempt, evidence, and evaluator metadata.
promotion: Only after all required levels pass may the college curriculum engine unlock unrestricted domain progression.
truth_rule: This file defines a gate. It does not prove Buddy has passed the gate; runtime benchmark evidence must be recorded separately.
